Ozinga Feed Service, Inc.
About Us
More Than Just a Feed Company – Service is Our Promise
Since 1982, Ozinga Feed Service, Inc. has been the trusted provider of high-quality animal feed and farm supplies in Oskaloosa, IA, proudly serving Mahaska, Marion, Monroe, Warren, Keokuk, Wapello, and surrounding counties. We specialize in producing both bagged and bulk feeds, offering tailored nutrition solutions. Our services include reliable feed delivery, durable farm equipment, and a comprehensive range of agricultural essentials. With decades of experience and a commitment to customer satisfaction, Ozinga Feed Service is the region's go-to source for dependable service and premium products, catering to farming operations of all sizes.
We are honored to have received the Certificate of Appreciation and Gold Award in 2024.
(641) 673-8863
Services
Feed Delivery – We offer dependable feed delivery services directly to your farm or facility, ensuring your livestock nutrition arrives on time and in optimal condition. Our efficient logistics keep operations running smoothly while saving you time and effort.
Bulk and Bag Delivery – Whether you need large quantities for commercial operations or smaller batches for individual needs, we provide flexible bulk and bagged feed delivery options. Each order is customized to suit your farm’s volume, storage preferences, and feed type.
Farm Equipment and Supplies – From daily farming essentials to durable equipment, our inventory includes tools, hardware, and specialized supplies that support efficient farm management. We help keep your agricultural operation well-stocked and productive.
Show Feeds – For competitive livestock and exhibition animals, we offer premium show feeds formulated for optimal condition, performance, and appearance. Our expert blends help your animals stand out in the ring and stay healthy year-round.
Products:
Domain Food Plot Seed, Cracked & Shelled Corn, Bagged Oats & Soybean Meal, Wood Shavings, Horse & Chicken Feed, Dog & Cat Food, Rodent Diet Food, Bale Rings, Mineral & Patriot Creep Feeders (Ask us about our 3 year payment plan), Bird Seed, Pond Supplies, Rolled Oats, Alfalfa Pellets, Beet Pulp, Ice Melts, Salts, Much more too!
Areas Served:
Monroe County, IA, Warren County, IA, Marion County, IA, Mahaska County, IA, Keokuk County, IA, Lucas County, IA, Wapello County, IA, Appanoose County, IA, Davis County, IA, Dallas County, IA, Poweshiek County, IA

FAQ
What services does Ozinga Feed Service, Inc. provide?
We offer high-quality animal feed, farm supplies, customized nutrition solutions, feed delivery, durable farm equipment, and various agricultural essentials.
Where is Ozinga Feed Service, Inc. located?
We are located in Oskaloosa, IA, serving Mahaska, Marion, Monroe, Warren, Keokuk, Wapello, and surrounding counties.
Since when has Ozinga Feed Service, Inc. been in operation?
We have been proudly serving the community since 1982.
What makes Ozinga Feed Service, Inc. stand out in the industry?
With decades of experience, we are committed to customer satisfaction, providing dependable service and premium products tailored to any size farming operation. We have also been recognized with the Certificate of Appreciation and Gold Award in 2024.
How can I contact Ozinga Feed Service, Inc.?
Contact us today to learn more about our services and how we can meet your farming needs with dedication and excellence.
